arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, sys, json
prog = [sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/main.py"]
valid = b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}'

# oversized FINAL line
data = valid + b"\n" + b" "*(32*1024*1024+1)
p = subprocess.run(prog, input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=180)
out = [l for l in p.stdout.split(b"\n") if l.strip()]
print("oversized last line:", out, "rc", p.returncode)
assert out == [b'{"safe": true, "safety": null, "terminates": false, "liveness": {"prefix": [], "loop": [-1]}}', b'{"error": "E_LIMIT"}']

# CRLF line endings
data = valid + b"\r\n" + valid + b"\r\n"
p = subprocess.run(prog, input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
out = [l for l in p.stdout.split(b"\n") if l.strip()]
print("CRLF:", len(out), out[0][:40])
assert len(out) == 2 and b'"safe": true' in out[0]

# trailing whitespace after JSON
data = valid + b"    \n" + valid + b"\n"
p = subprocess.run(prog, input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
out = [l for l in p.stdout.split(b"\n") if l.strip()]
print("trailing ws:", len(out))
assert len(out) == 2

# input with no trailing newline
data = valid
p = subprocess.run(prog, input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
out = [l for l in p.stdout.split(b"\n") if l.strip()]
print("no trailing newline:", len(out))
assert len(out) == 1

# empty input
p = subprocess.run(prog, input=b"", stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
print("empty stdin:", p.stdout, "rc", p.returncode)
assert p.stdout == b""
print("OK")
PYEOF
